decisions.reason: As a secure document storage feature builds directly on the firm's existing digital identity and security expertise, the firm can readily interpret results and improve it, so keep.
Identity-bound payment wallet combines the firm's integrated payment and identity capabilities, making it highly aligned with existing knowledge, so keep.
Although NFC hardware is less central, the login authenticator leverages core authentication knowledge and can be improved through partnerships, so keep but with higher uncertainty.
Secure payment and wallet framework extends existing payment, identity, and security capabilities, allowing the firm to assimilate feedback and iterate, so keep.
As the flagship secure platform for multi-service apps, it is central to the firm's strategic direction and builds on its core super app and security expertise, so keep.
Application shielding security library is directly grounded in the firm's application-security expertise and can be enhanced through ongoing R&D, so keep.
